messages:
Samantha: Hey everyone — first day! Quick question: who owns GitHub org access and SSH key whitelisting? I tried cloning the onboarding repo and got `permission denied` when running `git clone git@github.com:redwood/onboarding.git`. Any docs or a person to ping? Thanks :wave:
Devon: Welcome, Sam! :wave: For GH access please open an #access ticket with the 'github-access' template. For SSH keys we use the onboarding key form (internal-only link). If you can't access the form, drop your public key here and I'll route it to infra for faster approval.
Samantha: I can't reach the internal link from my laptop (VPN not set up yet). Can I paste the pubkey here?
Devon: Yep, paste it — mark the message `for infra` so it's obvious. If it's urgent I'll tag eng-infra directly.
Samantha: ```ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQD3... user@laptop``` (for infra)
Devon: Thanks — forwarding to joseph (eng-infra lead). @joseph can you add sam to the 'new-hires' GH team and whitelist the key? Sam, I'm adding a temporary label `urgent-access`.
Joseph: On it. Added Sam to org team and uploaded the key to gitadmin. You should receive an invite email in ~10 minutes. If you still can't clone after invite, let me know and I'll check org perms. For infra escalations faster than Slack, page eng-oncall via PagerDuty (see runbook: https://wiki.redwood/esc).
Anne: Welcome Samantha! I'm anne from People Ops. FYI the onboarding checklist is at https://wiki.redwood/onboarding-checklist — it covers VPN, Okta, laptop setup, and where to request keys. Weekly new-hire sync is Tue 10am (invite sent). DM me if anything's blocked. :smile:
Samantha: Got the invite email and can clone now. Thank you all :tada:
Devon: Quick note on ownership/escalation: runtime incidents -> ping #eng-runtime then page eng-sre for P1s. Infra platform/permissions -> eng-infra, infra SDK/library changes -> eng-platform. Security/policy questions -> eng-security + people-ops for approvals. If unsure tag both teams and add the `esc` label.
Samantha: One more question — who reviews codeowner PRs under `infra/automation`? Eng-infra or eng-platform?
Devon: Codeowner for `infra/automation` is eng-infra. If the PR touches the infra SDK (`platform/sdk`) also add eng-platform reviewers. When in doubt tag both and add `@eng-oncall` in the description for faster triage.
Samantha: Perfect, this is super helpful. Appreciate the quick responses!
onboarding-bot: Reminder: new-hire checklist item 'GitHub access' moved to completed for saman.
Devon: Cool — Sam, ping me anytime if you hit more blockers. Also add yourself to the team matrix doc (read-only link in the onboarding checklist) so folks know your owner mappings.
Samantha: Will do. Thanks again!
